description: This source file defines a CameraController actor that manages camera and microphone access, photo capturing, video recording, device enumeration, and associated error handling in an iOS application. It includes nested types for camera device info and error descriptions, as well as methods for snapping photos, clipping videos, listing devices, and performing media exports.

classes.name: PhotoCaptureDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for handling photo capture completion, returns photo data.

classes.name: MovieFileDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for handling video file recording completion.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo asynchronously with specified parameters and returns image data along with format, dimensions.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a short video clip asynchronously, transcodes to MP4, and returns data with format, duration, and audio info.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Lists available video capture devices with info such as id, name, position, and type.
